summary: The pair and covariance results are under-generalized: they are anchored to the fixed reference pair (X 0, X 1) while the one-coordinate analogue identDistrib_coord is stated for arbitrary i, j, and the underlying map_pair holds for every i < j. State the natural pairwise-uniform form.
